summary.business_type: Online professional service (1-on-1 English communication coaching)
top_findings: Site ranks 5th for 'Sean Watson English coach', behind podcast, LinkedIn and YouTube
No content targeting non-branded searches (5 pages, ~1,900 words)
Inner-page titles are 19-23 characters and name no topic
Server-rendered meta and og:description differ from the saved SEO description
Gamma ships ~4.8 MB of JavaScript per page
quick_wins: Add sameAs links to homepage schema
Fix social preview descriptions in Gamma
Add alt text to About headshot
Add Substack newsletter to the footer

findings.title: Raw description differs from rendered one
findings.description: Server HTML carries an auto-generated 305-character description; the saved description is only swapped in by JavaScript. og:description stays messy.
findings.recommendation: Check SEO and social preview descriptions in Gamma; report to Gamma if already set.

findings.title: Trailing-slash URLs return 404
findings.description: /about/ returns 404 instead of redirecting.
findings.recommendation: Ask Gamma support for trailing-slash redirects.

findings.title: No security headers
findings.description: No HSTS or CSP.
findings.recommendation: Platform-controlled; no action needed.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Clear B2+ audience and fit filter

findings.title: No non-branded content
findings.description: About 1,900 words site-wide, all service description.
findings.recommendation: Add a /lessons section and republish 1 piece a week.

findings.title: Services are one paragraph each
findings.description: Six services share one page.
findings.recommendation: Build a dedicated pronunciation and accent clarity page.

findings.title: No pricing signal
findings.description: No indication of cost.
findings.recommendation: Optionally add 'packages from' pricing.

findings.title: About page light on specifics
findings.description: Mostly market statistics.
findings.recommendation: Add how you work, TESL source, opera background details.

findings.title: Thin inner-page titles
findings.description: About, Coaching, Community and Contact titles are 19-23 characters with no topic.
findings.recommendation: Use the suggested titles in ACTION-PLAN.md.

findings.title: Vague inner-page H1s
findings.description: 'Meet Your Coach', 'Let's Talk' carry no topic.
findings.recommendation: Add the topic while keeping the voice.

findings.title: Heading levels skip
findings.description: H2 to H4 on homepage.
findings.recommendation: Template issue; low priority.

findings.title: Schema lacks sameAs and detail
findings.description: No sameAs, image, credential or knowsAbout; brand name is shared with other coaches.
findings.recommendation: Use the expanded schema in ACTION-PLAN.md.

findings.title: Schema is homepage-only and GTM-injected
findings.description: AI crawlers that skip JavaScript never see it.
findings.recommendation: Move into page HTML if Gamma allows; add Service and PodcastSeries.

findings.title: FAQ without FAQPage schema
findings.description: FAQ rich results were retired for all sites in May 2026.
findings.recommendation: No action needed.

findings.title: 4.8 MB of platform JavaScript
findings.description: Lighthouse mobile performance 27 (cloud lab run); 2.6 MB unused JS; 5.4 MB total page weight.
findings.recommendation: Platform-limited; revisit hosting if the site grows into a content hub.

findings.title: Google Tag Manager adds 119 KB
findings.description: GTM appears to inject only the schema.
findings.recommendation: Move schema into the page and drop GTM if unused otherwise.

findings.title: No quotable answer content
findings.description: Site describes services but answers no questions.
findings.recommendation: The /lessons section fixes this.

findings.title: Entity ambiguity
findings.description: Other Sean Watson coaches compete for the name.
findings.recommendation: sameAs links plus profiles linking back.

findings.title: No llms.txt
findings.description: No confirmed benefit.
findings.recommendation: Skip for now.

findings.title: Headshot missing alt attribute
findings.description: About-page headshot has no alt.
findings.recommendation: Alt: 'Sean Watson, English communication coach'.

findings.title: Empty alt on content photos
findings.description: Homepage and community photos have alt="".
findings.recommendation: Describe them if not decorative.

findings.title: Unsized images
findings.description: No width/height attributes.
findings.recommendation: Platform-controlled; CLS already 0.

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & Authority
items: Dedicated pronunciation and accent clarity page
